notes: per-file times exclude the one-time grammar compile (an untimed warm-up extraction precedes timing)
range_agreement not measured: the L1 oracle reported no end line for any matched definition, so L1 can be met at most at good, never excellent (design §1.2)
Subjects: mojolicious/mojo v9.50 (7b99f4ad, 280 files the harness reads: .pm, .t, .pl and extensionless perl scripts) and Perl-Critic/Perl-Critic v1.154 (382d701f, 263).

L1 oracle: universal-ctags 6.2.1 (tier B) with `--map-Perl=+.t` (it reads .pl .pm .ph .plx .perl and not .t): package and subroutine kinds; its constants (38), labels (38) and formats (2) are no dialect kind and are left out. Names are compared whole (manifest name_match identity): a package is `Mojo::Asset` to both, where the harness's bare rule would cut the dialect's to `Asset`. ctags writes no end line for a Perl definition, so range_agreement is not measured and L1 reads good, not excellent, whatever its recall and precision (.9997, .9982). Of the 6 dialect-only definitions, 5 are `async sub` subs in t/mojo/promise_async_await.t (Mojo::Base -async_await) that ctags misses and 1 is bin/perlcritic's `package main;` (line 3) that ctags does not tag; the 1 oracle-only definition is Perl::Critic's Capitalization.pm line 212, where ctags reads `subroutine` in a `qw< package subroutine ... >` list as a package. A `sub Pkg::name` is named `Pkg` by ctags and `Pkg::name` by the dialect (a name_match identity miss that neither subject has).

L2 oracle: PPI 1.270 (an independent Perl parser library, run by the machine's perl 5.34.1; calibration/oracles/ppi-calls, tier C): a call is a Word followed by a parenthesised list or directly by a term, or the Word after an arrow, paired with the named sub that encloses it, 4,207 pairs on mojo and 2,696 on Perl-Critic. A function named like a Perl builtin or keyword (perlfunc 5.34's list, with or without CORE::) is no call on either side; a method of that name is. The 125 dialect-only pairs (1.8%) are block and no-paren calls the oracle's term test does not see (`any { ... } @l`, `first { ... } @l`, `throw_policy_value policy => ...`, List::MoreUtils and Exception::Class helpers); the 5 oracle-only pairs are `return true() if ...` and `return false() if ...` in Mojo::JSON (real calls the dialect does not read) and the `STDOUT` filehandle word in Mojo::Server::CGI (a bareword PPI reads as a call) and the `_by_type` of `sort _by_type @{ $policies }` (a sort comparator's name) in PolicyListing.pm and ProfilePrototype.pm.

Known limits: a package statement is a one-line definition, so a sub of `package Foo;` is named `new` and not `Foo::new`; anonymous subs, typeglob assignments, `use constant`, variables and forward declarations are not definitions; the `use`/`require` graph is not read (L3 is not attempted). 4 files parse with an error under the pinned grammar (of 543).
Embedded grammar: perl.wasm.gz 2,443,271 bytes raw, 452,171 bytes gzip. The v2.0.0 tag ships no src/parser.c (29 MB generated), so the lock pins the release branch commit that adds it (4586b3f1).
